falseSynonyms.zh: previous 通常是『上一個／先前的』；last 還可表示『最後的』『持續』『上一次』等多個不同意思。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The previous meeting was cancelled. The last meeting of the year is in December.

falseSynonyms.zh: preceding 偏正式，常用於文本、步驟或明確序列；previous 更日常。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON See the preceding paragraph. I missed the previous lesson.

falseSynonyms.zh: prior 較正式，常出現在 approval、experience、knowledge 等固定搭配中，不一定表示緊接上一個。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Prior approval is required. The previous train was delayed.

falseSynonyms.zh: former 表示以前具有某身份／狀態；不是一般『上一個』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He is a former manager. The previous manager left in June.

falseSynonyms.zh: latest 是最新、最近期版本；last 在某些語境可指最近一次，但也可指最後一個。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I read the latest update. My last visit was in May.

falseSynonyms.zh: earlier 只表示更早，未必是直接上一個。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An earlier draft contained the note. The previous draft was shorter.

falseSynonyms.zh: penultimate 明確表示倒數第二，不等於一般 previous。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The penultimate chapter is short. The previous chapter explains the background.

falseSynonyms.zh: last 可作形容詞／名詞／副詞；lastly 是列舉時的副詞『最後』。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The last section is optional. Lastly, we need to discuss costs.
